CustomObject.description: Versioned, restricted diagnostics event for Record Health Check framework errors. Carries error metadata (message, exception type, stack trace) plus the record and check context needed to reproduce a failure, correlated by RunId. Publish Immediately (survives the rollback a failing check triggers), ERROR level by default. Persistence, retention, and reporting are owned by the Record Health Check extension package, not Framework.
CustomObject.label: Record Health Check Log
